headline.zh-CN: 并发访问与数据保存稳定性修复

summary.zh-CN: 修复并发请求共享数据库连接导致的查询异常和事务相互干扰，保障各请求独立读取、提交与回滚。
summary.en: Fix query failures and transaction interference caused by concurrent requests sharing a database connection, keeping reads, commits, and rollbacks isolated between requests.

description.zh-CN: 修复同时加载多个接口时可能出现的用户信息读取异常、列表内容错乱和请求报错。并发请求使用独立的数据库连接。
description.en: Fix user-information read failures, inconsistent lists, and request errors when multiple endpoints load simultaneously. Concurrent requests use separate database connections.

description.zh-CN: 修复一个请求结束或提交时可能影响其他请求待保存修改的问题，保留现有数据库外键约束与写入等待设置。
description.en: Fix requests closing or committing transactions affecting pending changes in other requests, while preserving foreign-key enforcement and database write-wait settings.
